ko.executive_summary: Co-packaged optics (CPO) technology is accelerating into mass production and broad ecosystem deployment, with NVIDIA's CPO switches reaching full-scale manufacturing and Coherent ramping 1.6T transceivers as CPO revenue scales. Industry interoperability standards are solidifying through OIF's multi-vendor demonstrations, while transceiver architectures—including Jabil's sub-13W 1.6T DR8 LRO with TFLN modulators and Credo DSP—are being optimized for AI data center power efficiency.
key_facts: Jabil 1.6T DR8 LRO optical transceiver: under 13W power, 200G per lane today, architected for 400G, uses HyperLight TFLN modulator and Credo half-retimed DSP
NVIDIA CPO switches in full-scale mass production; TSMC and Foxconn lead supply chain
Coherent Q4 FY2026: 1.6T transceiver ramp, CPO revenue approaching scale
OIF ECOC 2026 demo (September 21–23, Malaga): 39 member companies, 448G/224G CEI, CMIS, Co-Packaging, Energy Efficient Interfaces
Sivers Semiconductors and SemiNex: $3.4M InP (Indium Phosphide) program for AI data centers
Lightmatter and partners launch CPO Architecture Initiative within Open Compute Project (OCP)
Focuslight launches pitch error measurement system for Fiber Array Unit (FAU) manufacturing
Coractive launches double-clad EYDF (Erbium-Ytterbium Doped Fiber) for high-power optical amplifier applications

implications.text: Sub-13W 1.6T transceiver targets directly address AI data center thermal constraints; architecture evolution toward half-retimed DSP and TFLN modulators signals shift from raw speed to power-per-bit optimization.
TSMC and Foxconn dominance in CPO switch manufacturing establishes concentrated foundry/assembly ecosystem; limits alternative sourcing paths for hyperscalers.
OIF's 39-company booth and CEI/CMIS standardization reduce lock-in risk for cloud providers; multi-vendor transceiver compatibility accelerates CPO adoption velocity.
InP-based programs (Sivers/SemiNex) and integrated photonics platforms (Taara) indicate continued diversification beyond silicon, suggesting competitive pressure on all-Si architectures.
Focuslight's pitch error measurement and Gastech's cable blowing innovation address FAU assembly and field installation bottlenecks; critical for CPO deployment speed.

ko.counterpoint: 1.6T transceiver volume ramps remain dependent on AI infrastructure capex cycles; sustained hyperscaler ordering is not guaranteed if GPU/model architecture shifts reduce interconnect demand.
